**QA-29235: PASS.** The report is at `results/2026-10-28/QA-29235-report.md`.

- **Run configuration:** Wednesday row, Apple Services / Apple Music, on dev (`app.lfmdev.in`). Video Views data set, Jan 01–Dec 31, 2024, TikTok only. I scraped Table View, which showed 159 posts.
- **Views sum:** Organic + Paid + Unclassified Views equals Video Views on all 159 posts and on the Sum row (245,275,309).
- **Response rate:** Engagements / Video Views matches Video Response Rate on all 159 posts. The Average row shows 2.51% against a computed 2.5066%.
- **Organic Views:** it shows "–" on every TikTok post, and I treated it as 0 per the skill. I did not file this as a bug.
- **Bugs:** no open linked bugs, and nothing matched a known one. Nothing filed.
- **Not run:** the other Wednesday pair (NBCU EnterPrises / CNBC, NBC News). I took one pair per run, as the 10-26 and 10-27 runs did.
- **Case-file inconsistency:** the case's Notes line says Wednesday is Apple Services / Wasserman, which disagrees with the Description table. I used the table.
- **Prod tab:** the helper bootstrap also logged into prod. I didn't use that tab for any step.
